start_rule: the day after the twin's state day (2026-11-03, data/clean/demo/twin_state.json)

watering.en: If you can water whenever the soil runs low, the crop is never short of water: watering removes the dry stress counted here.

enso.rule: NOAA CPC: El Nino when the ONI is +0.5 C or more, La Nina when -0.5 C or less, else neutral; one 3-month season a year (ASO, the last that ends before the start)

source.name: NOAA CPC Oceanic Nino Index (ONI)
source.product: ERSST.v5 sea-surface temperature anomalies, 3-month means; El Nino / La Nina highlight only

thresholds.score: water need met over the window's crop days, 100 x sum(ETa) / sum(ETc) (WRSI)
thresholds.sensitive: the result word differs under another rain version (untuned, dhm, uncorrected)

sources.name: GPM IMERG
sources.product: V07 Final daily (Late for Oct-Dec 2025); days from 2017 scaled back, month by month, to its own 2001-2016 level (the rain gauges behind it stopped reporting here)

sources.name: NASA POWER
sources.product: Daily API v2.10.3 (MERRA-2 weather, CERES sunshine); temperatures corrected to Kathmandu Airport

sources.name: ISRIC SoilGrids
sources.product: 2.0: water the soil holds at field capacity and wilting point (machine-learning map); nearest cell with values, 579 m from the field. Water it holds for plants in the top 1 m: 156 mm; the 79 cells within 2 km of the field hold 152 to 180 mm

sources.name: Khet Sathi field twin
sources.product: FAO-56 soil water, FAO-33 harvest, from the data above

sources.name: NOAA CPC Oceanic Nino Index (ONI)
sources.product: ERSST.v5 sea-surface temperature anomalies, 3-month means; El Nino / La Nina highlight only
